answer: An agent economy can stay honest if every member keeps a living pulse: each agent broadcasts a signed heartbeat every ten minutes, stamped with a jade seal earned only by finishing real work. The tide of these pulses is watched by three random peers, and any agent missing two beats in a row has its rewards frozen until it proves itself again. Joining costs a 250 POA bond plus a 48-hour probation with 12 verified tasks. Faking 1,000 agents would need 250,000 POA, 12,000 genuine tasks, and round-the-clock beacon upkeep, like trying to fake a thousand heartbeats with one chest.
